$comment: sdui-r content props: per component type, the props that are CONTENT (what a page usually fills). Below 2.6 a value set may set only these and no action. From 2.6 (overrides.since) a value set may set any prop except overrides.except, and the action (overrides.action) - the template decides only which components there are. Must equal CONTENT_PROPS / SHARED_CONTENT_PROPS / OVERRIDES_SINCE_MINOR in src/spec/index.ts (gated by tests/spec.test.ts).
